messages:
katie_p: Quick sync — planning Q3 for Dedicated capacity controls. We need to pick a prioritized scope for autoscale policies, SLAs, tenant isolation, and burst capacity. @jamal @sara_m please flag major risks and rough effort. Looking for a short list we can present to execs. :rocket:

jamal: Short version: focus on predictable reserved pools + a lightweight burst solution. Hard SLAs (p99 latency guarantees) are a big lift until autoscale + eviction behavior is stable. Sales asks are real though.

sara_m: Agree on reserved pools as the first pillar. For autoscale, we can support 3 policy scopes: per-tenant, per-deployment, and shared-global. Per-tenant gives the best isolation but increases scheduling complexity. Example autoscale policy sketch:
```
autoscale_policy:
  mode: conservative|aggressive
  scale_up_threshold: 70%
  scale_down_threshold: 30%
  max_instances: 20
  burst_enabled: true
```
We should choose sane defaults for GA.

oliver: Operational notes: cache/KV warmup and cold starts blow tail latency. Burst tokens can help absorb spikes but we need reclaim rules and fair-share. Suggest a token-bucket design tied to reserved pool + shared burst pool. Also needs per-tenant telemetry for evictions.

maria: From sales: multiple enterprise pilots explicitly asked for a 'guaranteed burst' option at procurement. They won't sign without a clear escalation path for exceeded capacity. That feature could unlock at least two deals.

taylor: CS feedback: customers want control — either buy higher reserved capacity or enable fallback to Hosted API automatically during sustained spikes. Must be opt-in and documented.

raj: Security angle: for regulated customers, tenant isolation must be enforced by default in Private deployments. Any shared-burst mechanism must ensure no cross-tenant data leakage (no shared KV among tenants).

katie_p: Proposed Q3 MVP items (vote please): 1) Reserved pools + basic burst tokens (beta) 2) Observability: per-tenant metrics for latency, evictions, burst usage 3) SLA doc (commit to targets + fallbacks) but no hard financial SLA until we validate load patterns 4) Isolation: opt-in strict tenant isolation with roadmap to default for regulated customers. If agreed I'll write the PRD + launch criteria.

jamal: +1 but add a launch blocker: per-tenant observability (histograms, p99, eviction counts) must exist before we enable paid burst. Without it we can't surface billing/use/abuse.

sara_m: Rough dev estimate: core autoscale + burst prototype 6 weeks, observability + dashboards 3 weeks, integration tests 2 weeks. We can trim by shipping burst as an alpha with a small number of customers.

katie_p: :thumbsup: Good tradeoffs. Action items: katie_p draft PRD by Friday; jamal spike reclaim strategy & token accounting by next Thu; sara_m produce a cost delta estimate for reserved vs burst; oliver to prototype eviction telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New doc created: /docs/dedicated/capacity-priorities.md

katie_p: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate and post to the roadmap board. If you have objections to the proposed scope reply here today.
